object.name: evi_formlet
object.description: A physical modelling ringing formlet filter loosely based on SuperCollider 'Formlet()' with added modulation and control features. Created by adding two resonant filters together around a center frequency. Can create ringing tones out of any input material. This is a direct form filter, so modulation is limited.

inlets.name: input
inlets.digest: Audio input to be filtered, typically an impulse-like event.

inlets.name: filter
inlets.digest: Filter frequency is set in Pitch (e.g. MIDI 0..127).

attributes.name: attack
attributes.description: Filter ringing T60 attack time in ms. Like setting an envelope attack.

attributes.name: decay
attributes.description: Filter ringing T60 decay time in ms. Like setting an envelope decay. Note this is a T60 time and therefore does not reach it's destination exactly.

attributes.name: offset
attributes.description: Modulation in semitones. Set in Pitch, filter cutoff (inlet 2) offset ± 2 octaves.

attributes.name: smoothfreq
attributes.description: Optional frequency (inlet 2) smoothing time in ms.

attributes.name: smoothtime
attributes.description: Optional @attack / @decay smoothing time in ms. In general this is not needed.

attributes.name: spread
attributes.description: Modulation in semitones. Set in Pitch, bandwidth spread ± 1 octave. This spreads the cutoffs of the two internal resonant filters apart from one another.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Modulation in semitones. Set in Pitch, bandwidth up to 2 octaves in size. This sets the size of the frequency band centered by the cutoff (inlet 2).
